intent: Record as reviewed further rules the creation Context enforces and tests.
observable_outcome: get-context creation lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Raising a creation budget is refused unless the new amount is finite, strictly above the current budget and within the ceiling.
Raising the budget of a failed creation returns it to waiting for input; any other state is kept, and no step is queued.
A creation command is refused as a conflict unless its expected revision equals the stored one.
A saved or cancelled creation accepts no command, not even cancel.
While a creation is queued for or working with the model, only cancel and stop-step are accepted; other commands conflict.
A creation may take a step only while it has taken fewer than its approved number of steps, even with budget left.
At the tool-call ceiling a creation's tool request is refused and the count does not grow.
A creation searches the catalogue at most twice; a third search is answered with a note and searches nothing.
Selecting more than three reference Skills is refused.
Selecting the same reference Skill twice is refused.
Adopting a reference names exactly one listed Skill.
